pages.text: Shortcut Terminal exposes a public API so any mod can add its own commands to the terminal.$(br2)In your mod's $(o)FMLCommonSetupEvent$():$(br2)$(c)ShortcutTerminalAPI.registerCommand("hello", $(br)(cmd, args) -> "Hello!", "Says hello");$(0)$(br2)Then run $(c)hello$(0) in the terminal.$(br2)Type $(c)addons$(0) to list all registered addon commands.

pages.title: API Reference
pages.text: $(li)registerCommand(name, handler, info) - register a command$(br)$(li)registerModule(name, handler, info) - register a run module$(br)$(li)unregisterCommand / unregisterModule - remove$(br)$(li)hasCommand / hasModule - query$(br)$(li)getRegisteredCommands - list all$(br2)Reserved names (help/ls/pkg/run etc.) cannot be overridden; registration will be rejected and logged.

pages.title: Dependency Setup
pages.text: Add to your $(o)build.gradle$():$(br)$(c)implementation "unsa.st.com:shortcutterminal:1.0.1"$(0) (or a local jar)$(br2)In $(o)neoforge.mods.toml$():$(br)$(c)[[dependencies.yourmodid]]$(br)modId="shortcutterminal"$(br)type="required"$(br)ordering="AFTER"$(0)$(br2)This ensures the API is ready when your registration code runs.
